description_en: Deletes a specified port list. All port list entries in the port list are also deleted
description_zh: 删除指定端口列表，同时端口列表下的端口列表条目都将被删除
kebab_example: aliyun ecs delete-port-range-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --port-range-list-id prl-2ze97430000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePortRangeList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the port list. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 端口列表所在地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The port list ID.

If the port list is associated with other resources, it cannot be deleted. Dissociate the port list from the resources before you delete it
parameters.help_zh:
端口列表 ID。

如果当前端口列表已关联其他资源，则无法删除，需解除关联后删除
parameters.name: port_range_list_id
